home.headline: Quantitative research.
home.lead: An agent-native harness for quantitative code development, experiment execution, and result analysis. Use your research prompt and AxonX Skill to develop or improve plugins with an external or built-in Agent.
home.showcaseLead: From task execution to result interpretation, inspect your research in one workspace.
home.caseTitle: Improving Alpha158 with factors and portfolio policies
home.caseDescription: An Agent develops market cross-sectional features and rank-retention policies as plugins on the Alpha158 baseline. Top20 net annualized returns are 7.67%, 9.03% and 32.37% for baseline, risk factors and the 3-day policy, with 0.05% buy / 0.15% sell fees. Market data is incomplete; there is no independent confirmation window.
home.closingDescription: The built-in demo needs no external data or model credentials.
